pricing.lead: The core is free. You only pay for deeper analysis and larger limits.

items.q: Can I use it for free?
items.a: Yes. Profile, career selection, skill analysis, courses and applications are all on the free plan, with limits.

items.q: I'm still at school. Is this for me?
items.a: Yes. The system works from where you are now, not from your age. Career selection is built for exactly this stage.

items.q: What if I don't know what I want to do?
items.a: That is the most common case. It starts with diagnostics and proposes a direction from the result.

items.q: Will employers see my personal data?
items.a: Until you apply, your profile is shown anonymously. Personal details are revealed only by your decision.
By a test, a course, work experience, a mentor or an employer. Each source carries a different weight.
